####
# WSTS toolkit example project: HubDemo
#
# An ordinary F Prime project with two deployments, one per flight computer, that knows
# nothing about simulation. The simulated system is generated by `fprime-wsts generate`
# from wsts-system.yaml (see the repository README).
####
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)
project(HubDemoProject VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

find_package(FPrime REQUIRED PATHS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../lib/fprime/cmake")

add_fprime_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Components")
add_fprime_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Cdh")
add_fprime_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Payload")
